pages.text: Bottles are very useful, as they can be used to store blood.

By pressing $(#a51e12)$(l)$(k:key.sanguinisluxuria.drain_blood)$() while holding an empty bottle and not looking at any living thing with blood, it will take some blood from your blood bar and store it in the bottle.$(br2)While Blood Bottles can stack up to 16, they can only store 2 units of blood each.
Using a Blood Bottle on a block while crouching will cause it to place blood on the ground.
When filling any blood-storing item, it can be made to track the last drained being by crouching.
